messages:
Kai: Hi folks — just trying to install the company VPN client (AcmeVPN) on my new MBP (M2) and it launches but then shows 'System Extension Blocked' and won't establish a tunnel. In System Settings > Privacy & Security there's a note: 'System software from developer "AcmeCorp" was blocked' but the Allow button is disabled and it says 'settings managed by your organization'. Any way to get this working?
Jordan (IT): Welcome, Kai. Sounds like a kernel/system extension (kext) or system extension approval is required and our MDM policy hasn't pre-approved AcmeCorp's Team ID. Can you paste the output of `spctl kext-consent list` and `kmutil showloaded | grep -i acme`? If you prefer, send serial and I'll check the device record.
Kai: Serial: C02M2XQA9L1. spctl output: 'kext-consent: com.apple.kext-consent:  ---' (no acme entries). kmutil shows nothing for acme.
MDM-Bot: Device C02M2XQA9L1 enrolled (profile: corp-managed-mac). Kernel extension consent: not configured for third-party Team IDs. Last check-in: 2026-07-22T09:10:05Z.
Jordan (IT): Ok — two paths: 1) We can update the MDM profile to include AcmeCorp's Team ID in the kernel extension consent list and push it (auto-approve), or 2) we can do a temporary supervised change via remote session where I authenticate and approve the extension on your device. The MDM route is preferable since it scales and we can remove it later if needed. Do you want me to push the Team ID now?
Kai: MDM route sounds better. If it's safe to add, go ahead. I need VPN for the day.
Nina: Adding the Team ID via MDM requires a profile update and a restart to take effect (kext consent is read during boot). Jordan, if you push it now Kai will need to reboot once after accepting the profile.
Jordan (IT): Pushing MDM update to add TeamID: ACME1234TEAM (push includes system-extension policy and network extension entitlement). You should get a profile install prompt in System Settings. After accepting, reboot the Mac.
MDM-Bot: Profile update queued for C02M2XQA9L1: add-kext-consent (TeamID: ACME1234TEAM). Initiated by Jordan (IT).
Kai: Got the prompt to install the new configuration profile. Accepted.
Jordan (IT): Reboot when ready and then try launching AcmeVPN. If it still complains, run `log show --style syslog --predicate 'process == "kernel" OR subsystem == "com.apple.kext"' --last 5m` and paste any errors.
[Kai reboots]
Kai: Rebooted. Launched AcmeVPN and it now asks to allow a 'Network Extension' — clicked allow. Tunnel came up!
VPN-Bot: AcmeVPN client connection established for Kai: 10.22.7.45 -> corp-gw-1.
Kai: Confirmed VPN and corporate resources load. Thanks! Quick follow-up: the VPN installer also asked for Full Disk Access to observe network (it showed in Privacy & Security). Do we allow that?
Jordan (IT): Yes — the VPN needs Full Disk/Network Extensions to inspect traffic for split-tunnel rules. Our MDM policy will push the TCC (Full Disk / Network) approvals for the app bundle ID now that kext consent is configured. You may see an additional prompt to accept those settings.
MDM-Bot: Pushed TCC exemptions for AcmeVPN (Full Disk Access, Network Volume Access) to C02M2XQA9L1.
Kai: Saw the additional prompts and accepted. Everything looks operational. Appreciate the fast fix.
Jordan (IT): Closing loop — logged ticket IT-5389 to track the MDM kext consent change and approvals. If anyone else hits this, reply here and we'll push the TeamID to the fleet.
Kai: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
